title: YourRAGE Realizes He’s Sinking Mid-Conversation
caption: YourRAGE realizes he’s sinking mid-conversation. The panic lasts about as long as it takes somebody to call him a scammer. #YourRAGE #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: Why did he say it like he was just noticing the weather 😭
why: The sudden sinking callout interrupts casual banter, and the deadpan scammer exchange adds a second laugh.
